title.zh: 无明的边界条件：寻求恰在目标于展开所不变的状态被满足之处静止；“比现在更多”需要开放的世界，“高于一切他者”不同时满足两个；不断上升需要不衰减的步，衰减不断则上升停止
title.en: The boundary condition for 无明: seeking rests exactly where its target is met at a state the unfolding leaves unchanged; more than now needs an open world and above all others never holds of two; rising without end needs steps that do not run down, and running down stops it

claim.zh: 在确定的律 next 之下，从 s 出发的轨道从某步起带着满足的目标静止，恰当它到达一个 next 不变、满足目标的状态（Law.rests_iff）；在这样的状态满足的目标此后每步都满足（Law.fixed_rests）。“比现在更多”，即自身的一个量 q 跨过一步上升（MoreThanNow），只由变化满足（more_not_at_rest、Law.more_never_rests）；每步都满足时任意两个较晚的步之间 q 都上升（more_rises），所以每个配置都是新的（more_new），没有列表容纳它们（more_needs_open，unlisted_of_new 的实例）；往上数满足它（succ_more）。“高于一切他者”，即其他每个寻求者的量都低于自己的（AboveAll），在一个状态至多被一个寻求者满足（aboveAll_unique、aboveAll_not_two），所以在任何律之下，没有律所不变的状态对两个寻求者都满足它（Law.aboveAll_never_rests）。所立者每步被列出（Web.StandingCensus）时，在任意晚处上升的条件，需要在任意晚处有所立者不衰减的步（Flow.more_needs_unrun，由 Flow.change_recurs_iff）；所立者从某步起每步衰减时，没有条件在任意晚处上升（Flow.more_exhausted）。不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Under a determined law next, the orbit from s comes to rest with its target met from some step on exactly when it reaches a state next leaves unchanged that meets the target (Law.rests_iff); a target met at such a state is met at every later step (Law.fixed_rests). More than now, a quantity q of one's own rising across the step (MoreThanNow), is met only by change (more_not_at_rest, Law.more_never_rests); met at every step, q rises between any two later steps (more_rises), so every configuration is new (more_new) and no list holds them (more_needs_open, an instance of unlisted_of_new); counting on meets it (succ_more). Above all others, every other seeker's quantity below one's own (AboveAll), is met at a state by at most one seeker (aboveAll_unique, aboveAll_not_two), so under any law no state left unchanged meets it for two seekers (Law.aboveAll_never_rests). Where what stands is listed at each step (Web.StandingCensus), a condition rising at arbitrarily late steps needs, at arbitrarily late steps, steps across which what stands does not run down (Flow.more_needs_unrun, from Flow.change_recurs_iff); where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.more_exhausted). No Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 目标是配置上的任一条件；目标怎样形成没有建模。rests_iff 设律确定；B2 设所立者每步被列出，这是写在定理中的局部条件。
hypotheses.en: A target is any condition on the configuration; how a target forms is not modelled. rests_iff assumes a determined law; B2 assumes what stands is listed at each step, a local condition written into the theorems.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的量。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number quantities.

correspondence.zh: Ren 10 月 10 日：“the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)”，“find the boundary condition for 无明”；10 月 11 日：“yes let's do 无明”。无明边界计划的 B1（够）与 B2（扩张或耗尽）在这里陈述；B3（反馈）与 B4（明）是 P49、P53、P55 的定理读到寻求上，不重述；B5（劫持）没有陈述。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：无明是使寻求锁定在不能于静止中满足之目标上的不见，其边界是 B1；明是识及支持所不标记者的识；知足、知止是边界之内的目标；支配本身不在所排除者之内。见整合文档 §83。
correspondence.en: Ren on 10 October: “the seeking system got locked in, what they are pursuing is illusion(in south asia and Buddhism)” and “find the boundary condition for 无明”; on 11 October: “yes let's do 无明”. B1 (enough) and B2 (expansion or exhaustion) of the 无明 boundary plan are stated here; B3 (feedback) and B4 (明) are the theorems of P49, P53 and P55 read for seeking, not restated; B5 (hijacking) is not stated. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): 无明 is the not-seeing that keeps seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, and its boundary is B1; 明 is registration reaching what support does not mark; 知足 and 知止 are targets within the boundary; dominance as such is not the target ruled out. See §83 of the integration note.

detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, orbit_add, gap_of_lt, gap_of_le, unlisted_of_new and Law.succ_open.

output.zh: 永不重访需要开放；律的轨道。
output.en: Never revisiting needs openness; the orbit of a law.

input.zh: “比现在更多”需要开放的世界；够的边界。
input.en: More than now needs an open world; the boundary of enough.

detail.zh: 复用 Web.StandingCensus、Flow.RunsDown 与 Flow.change_recurs_iff：持续的变化需要开放。
detail.en: Reuses Web.StandingCensus, Flow.RunsDown and Flow.change_recurs_iff: continued change needs openness.

output.zh: 持续的变化需要所立者不衰减的步。
output.en: Continued change needs steps at which what stands does not run down.

conditions.en: What stands is listed at each step.

detail.zh: B3、B4 的一部分：主张只经所识的差别被否证；识闭包之外的不被识。
detail.en: Part of B3 and B4: a claim is refuted only through a difference in what registers; nothing beyond the registration closure registers.

detail.zh: B3：断裂之前，断裂还有多远不被识。
detail.en: B3: before the break, how far off it is does not register.

detail.zh: B4：自己的动作造成什么，只在配置返回之处、在关于何者无关的模型之下被固定。
detail.en: B4: what one's own act does is fixed only where the configuration returns, under a model of what is irrelevant.

detail.zh: 那里不断取用的有限家族被围住时不能由其外供给；这里不断上升需要所立者不衰减的步。
detail.en: There a finite family that keeps taking cannot, enclosed, go on fed from beyond; here rising without end needs steps at which what stands does not run down.

detail.zh: 边界：“比现在更多”可以每步都被满足，但只经变化、只在开放的世界中：数下去（`succ_more`）每步都满足它，却从不静止（`Law.more_never_rests`），也没有列表持有它经过的配置（`more_needs_open`）。
detail.en: Boundary: more than now can be met at every step, but only by change and only in an open world: counting on (`succ_more`) meets it at every step and never rests (`Law.more_never_rests`), and no list holds the configurations it passes through (`more_needs_open`).

detail.zh: 边界：“高于一切他者”在一个状态至多被一个寻求者满足（`aboveAll_unique`、`aboveAll_not_two`），所以对含两个寻求者的家族，律所不变的状态都不同时满足它（`Law.aboveAll_never_rests`）。
detail.en: Boundary: above all others is met by at most one seeker at a state (`aboveAll_unique`, `aboveAll_not_two`), so for a family holding two seekers no state the law leaves unchanged meets it for both (`Law.aboveAll_never_rests`).

limitations.zh: 目标怎样形成、怎样修正，寻求者追求其目标，实际形成持有哪些目标，都不推出；劫持（B5）另在 target-capture 中陈述；rests_iff 只对确定的律；B2 只说上升不再复现，耗尽终结寻求者自身没有陈述；B1 的计数是初等的，实质在于把它们陈述为展开之中的目标；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: How a target forms or is revised, that a seeker pursues it, and which targets actual formations hold are not derived; hijacking (B5) is stated separately, in target-capture; rests_iff is for determined laws only; B2 says only that the rises stop recurring, not that exhaustion ends the seekers themselves; the counting of B1 is elementary, and the substance is in stating it of targets within the unfolding; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：Becoming.Seeking 的 13 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 Law.rests_iff、more_needs_open、aboveAll_unique、Flow.more_needs_unrun 与 Flow.more_exhausted；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T095049.338744Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §83；未作独立审查，是否需要交 Ren。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 13 theorems of Becoming.Seeking all have empty axiom reports, among them Law.rests_iff, more_needs_open, aboveAll_unique, Flow.more_needs_unrun and Flow.more_exhausted; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §83 of the integration note; not independently reviewed, whether it needs a review is Ren's call.

next_delta.zh: B5，劫持：目标怎样形成与传递，赢得更多以赢者怎样选择不能静止的目标，接上元吸引子的结果；耗尽在活动需要支持之处终结寻求者自身；不确定的律中够的边界。
next_delta.en: B5, hijacking: how targets form and are transmitted, and how winning that buys more power to win selects targets that cannot rest, joined to the meta-attractor's results; exhaustion ending the seekers themselves where activity needs support; the boundary of enough under undetermined laws.
